title: What is the name and major of members who had to spend more than a hundred
question: What is the name and major of members who had to spend more than a hundred dollars on an expense?

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT m.full_name, mj.major_name
FROM member AS m
JOIN expense AS e ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member
LEFT JOIN major AS mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id
WHERE e.cost > 100
